name: sanitize HTML in place of executable content while preserving structure
definition: Strip script/dangerous event-source bodies and attributes from an input HTML file in place while leaving safe tables/text/formatting unchanged, and verify a crafted payload no longer executes in a browser runtime.
failure_mode: no real-browser validation leaves a fragile payload that breaks when the verifier runs it

name: send commands and run a long-running process inside a specific tmux pane
definition: Navigate to and target a particular pane, then issue a command (launch a monitor or processing script) into that pane.
failure_mode: Command sent to wrong pane or never executed
